values.binNote: Wiki shows a proximity-based value ranging from 0.5 to 1 seconds; bin lists StunDuration=1 (max) and StunDurationMin=0.5 (min) separately.

mechanics.claim: The windblast knocks back enemies hit and stops upon hitting Terrain.
mechanics.quote: sweeps a windblast in the target direction that {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} enemies hit by {{tt|375 units|estimated}}, though not through terrain, and stops upon hitting {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}}.

mechanics.claim: A separate shockwave, triggered by River, Brush, or Terrain borders, deals the physical damage and stun; this is distinct from the windblast itself which deals no damage.
mechanics.quote: The windblast creates a cascading shockwave across any {{sbc|{{as|River}}}} or {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}}} it passes through, as well as around the borders of {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} it reaches, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: The percent-max-health damage component is capped against monsters, using the separate Capped Monster Health Damage value.
mechanics.quote: The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: Projectile-intercepting effects block the windblast but not the shockwave.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Projectile|Projectile-intercepting}} effects will block the windblast but not the shockwave.

mechanics.claim: The shockwave needs only to reach near terrain to trigger the terrain shockwave.
mechanics.quote: The windblast needs only to reach near terrain to trigger the terrain shockwave.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by spell shields.
